headline: Attack the one real mechanism behind every observed 4/5 — an unresolved defect-class minor in the terminal re-review — with a structural consistency script at the producer and reviser, producer-side rules for the three known AC/boundary defect classes, a narrowing rule that stops the re-review from escalating already-surfaced health warnings, and a reviser must-fix discriminator calibrated against every observed minor.

clusters.name: unresolved defect-class minor in terminal re-review -> judge 4/5
clusters.detail: The external judge (decomposition_quality, rubric: '4 = one minor gap') reads the pipeline's final adversarial review; every observed 4/5 cites a defect-class minor left unresolved in that file, and every observed 5/5 had a clean or observation-only final review. The loop ends at pass:true (minors never fail), so defects the first review misses, the reviser leaves, or the re-review newly finds are never fixed. Sub-classes: A1 mermaid/frontmatter edge mismatch (cand_0002-019 first review; seed-018 post-decompose true positive); A2 parallel-supplier AC-precision gap (cand_0002-019 re-review: stub fixture covers only one launch path); A3 re-review escalating already-surfaced health warnings into Completeness minors (cand_0002-013 regression); A4 spec-vs-content overlap (seed-019); A5 rollout-gate AC gap (seed-019); A6 reviser leaves prescriptive minors unfixed (seed-019: all three stayed).

clusters.name: latent: reviewer pedantry draw on passing tasks (cand_0002's 013 break)
clusters.detail: cand_0002 broke case-013 (1.0 -> 0.75) via three Completeness minors that appeared only in the re-review, each mirroring a health warning the decomposer had already surfaced ('Flagged in Health Warning #N; Confirm with the strategy author'). The seed-013 run had the same health warnings, a clean review, and 5/5 — the delta is the reviewer/re-review draw, plausibly amplified by cand_0002's reviewer pattern-naming edits. This cluster is the regression mechanism this iteration's reviewer edit (A3 narrowing) is designed to close.

edits.title: New structural consistency script check_decomposition.py (--self-check 9/9)
edits.verified: Self-check 9/9; catches exactly cand_0002-019's first-review defect (missing E001->E005 mermaid arrow) on the reconstructed post-decompose state, fix loop closes to exit 0; CLEAN on all 8 tasks' final artifacts and 7/8 post-decompose states (seed-018: one TRUE finding whose fix converges to the already-5/5 final state); CLEAN on cand_0002-013 (not implicated in that regression); primary/fallback/unavailable invocation branches executed in a replica of the runtime layout.

edits.title: Decompose Step 8c: fail-open consistency-check invocation (dual-path, fix-once)
edits.verified: Exact snippet smoke-tested in the runtime layout; on passing tasks the only delta is one Bash call printing OK (post-decompose states CLEAN); fires only on real structural inconsistencies.

edits.title: Decompose Step 5: spec-vs-content boundary rule + different-domain worked example
edits.verified: Trigger (spec epic beside non-docs content epic) absent from all 7 passing tasks; the same rule in cand_0002 verifiably produced a clean external dim-2 on 019.

edits.title: Decompose Step 7: parallel-supplier AC completeness rule + different-domain example
edits.verified: Trigger (ACs verifying against a parallel epic's supplied artifacts) grepped absent from all passing tasks; targets cand_0002-019's re-review defect (stub fixture vs both launch paths).

edits.title: Decompose Step 7: rollout-gate AC coverage rule with exclusions
edits.verified: Feature-flag scope among passing tasks exists only in 014-E005 whose gate ACs already satisfy the rule; 013's CI/approval-gate epics named in the exclusions; targets seed-019's third minor.

edits.title: Review Criterion 7: already-surfaced strategy ambiguity is not a Completeness issue (narrowing only)
edits.verified: No passing task's final review lists a health-warning mirror (seed-013 clean over the same health warnings cand_0002-013's reviewer escalated); rule only removes listings, adds nothing.

edits.title: Revise Step 2: defect-vs-observation must-fix discriminator for minors
edits.verified: Discriminator checked against all 12 observed minors: seed-019's 3 prescriptive ones -> fixed; all 7 passing-task minors and cand_0002-013's 3 -> classified observation (latitude unchanged, including 016's signal-value comparison, explicitly carved out).

edits.title: Revise recipes: spec/content overlap (stub or subsume, never merge, + supplier-AC sweep) and missing rollout-gate AC
edits.verified: Recipe signatures absent from all passing tasks' review issue lists.

edits.title: Revise Step 4: propagation of dep/AC changes + fail-open script run
edits.verified: Script CLEAN on all 8 final states -> no-op on current trajectories; propagation rules fire only when corrections touched dependencies or producer ACs.

edits.title: SKILL.md description: add 'Use when' (clears standing validation warning)
edits.verified: 199 chars < 1024, third person, no XML tags/ALL-CAPS; same triggers.
